headword: {天体観測|てんたいかんそく}

definitions.explanation: The observation of celestial bodies such as stars, planets, and other astronomical objects, either for scientific study or as a hobby.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}で{天体観測|てんたいかんそく}をした。
examples.english: I did astronomical observation in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {天体観測|てんたいかんそく}には{暗|くら}い{場所|ばしょ}が{最適|さいてき}だ。
examples.english: Dark locations are ideal for stargazing.

examples.japanese: {望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}を{買|か}って{天体観測|てんたいかんそく}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I bought a telescope and started doing astronomical observation.

notes:
FORMATION:
{天体|てんたい} (celestial body) + {観測|かんそく} (observation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{天体観測|てんたいかんそく}をする (to do astronomical observation)
・{天体観測|てんたいかんそく}に{行|い}く (to go stargazing)

EQUIPMENT:
・{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう} (telescope)
・{双眼鏡|そうがんきょう} (binoculars)
・{星座|せいざ}{早見表|はやみひょう} (star chart)

RELATED:
・{星|ほし}{見|み} (stargazing - casual term)
・{天文学|てんもんがく} (astronomy - academic field)
